0022600125.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West, on a three-game winning streak) in the Hawks' fourth game of the season. Atlanta is 2-0 on the road and 0-1 at home, while Houston is 1-0 at home, and the Hawks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 121-114 loss in Atlanta on October 24, following an 0-2 series loss to Houston in 2025-26. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain), and Steven Adams (ankle).
